notes: 修复 0.4.17 拉取前置检查过严：link: 插件归档检查同时认 .tgz/.zip（仓库里实际是 .zip，旧版只查 .tgz 误报缺失）；workspaceHome 目录不存在时自动补建而非拦死拉取。避免目标机首次拉取因前置检查失败被回滚、工作区/会话落不了地。
notesEn: Fix over-strict 0.4.17 pull preflight: link: plugin archives now accept .tgz/.zip (repos actually use .zip; old check only looked for .tgz and falsely reported missing); workspaceHome directory is auto-created instead of blocking pull. Prevents first pull on a second machine from failing preflight and rolling back, leaving workspace/sessions unlanded.
